hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/*) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx) "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/node_modules/.bin/biome" check --write "$f" >&2 || exit 2; case "$f" in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/package/*) "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/node_modules/.bin/tsc" -p "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/package" --noEmit >&2 || exit 2;; "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/example/*) "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/node_modules/.bin/tsc" -p "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/example" --noEmit >&2 || exit 2;; esac;; esac; }
